floors.reason: The safety kernel decides what is permitted. Every mutation passes through it (C-07).
The workspace's only exception to forbid(unsafe_code) (ADR-0017), and the seam through which every filesystem mutation is performed.
Identity decides whether the thing acted on at mutation time is the thing that was planned. A wrong answer here defeats every check upstream of it.
Provider trust is an authority boundary: a manifest must never be able to grant itself a capability (C-05).
The Python reference still performs real deletion. It is frozen, not inert.
Policy resolution decides eligibility. It cannot mutate, but it decides what may be.
Release authority: what is cut, and on what evidence.
Classification and scan completeness. An incomplete scan reported as complete is how unknown becomes absent (C-02).
Adapters produce the capability results planning consumes.
A dependency added to a kernel-ring crate is an authority decision requiring its own reviewed ADR (ADR-0019). The manifest is where that happens, so it carries the crate's floor.
Kernel ring, and the only crate exempt from forbid(unsafe_code) (ADR-0017).

The domain model defines what an artifact, an authority and a plan are. It cannot mutate, but every decision downstream is expressed in its types.
SI-019: the only seam permitted to call std::fs::remove_*. This is the mutation boundary itself.
Root resolution decides which directory may be acted on at all.
Path resolution is where a name becomes a target; a wrong answer here defeats every check upstream of it.
Platform behaviour is where identity, links and process observation are decided. Narrower CR4 patterns above take precedence, because the highest floor wins.
A test cannot grant authority, but weakening the kernel's own tests removes the evidence its authority rests on.

overrides.reason: A mechanical lint rewrite of one descending sort into sort_by_key(Reverse(..)) in atlas.rs's top-contributor list. That list is presentation ordering for the atlas summary: it decides no eligibility, grants no authority, and reaches no mutation. The floor on cancellai-policy/src exists because policy decides what may be deleted, and this edit is downstream of every such decision. The ordering it produces is pinned by the atlas tests, which pass unchanged.
